paper_title: Searching for dark matter with an unequal delay interferometer
notes: DAMNED unequal-delay interferometer at Paris Observatory searches for oscillating scalar DM via variation of fine-structure constant (d_e, ScalarPhoton) and electron mass (d_me, ScalarElectron) in mass range [4.1e-11, 8.3e-10] eV (10-200 kHz). Paper constrains BOTH d_e and d_me using a maximum-reach approach, so coupling type is ambiguous between ScalarPhoton and ScalarElectron (hint suggests ScalarElectron). 95% CL limits presented in two models (galactic DM with rho=0.4 GeV/cm^3, and Earth relaxion halo). Numerical limits only available in Fig. 3 (no data table); no extractable (mass, coupling) pairs in text, hence empty data_points. | Vision: Top-left panel shows galactic DM 95% upper limit on d_e (ScalarElectron) from DAMNED experiment (green curve). The exclusion region is above the curve. Sharp downward spikes (sensitivity peaks) reach much lower values e.g. near 1.02e-10 and 1.9e-10 eV. EP and Antypas 2019 lines also shown but DAMNED is the primary new result. X-axis converted from m_phi in eV/c^2. | Calibration: No calibration needed | Auto-corrected couplings: ×1.00e-04 (4 orders too large)
